summary.intent: Fix a failing vault recovery E2E test in CI, resolve cascading staging deployment failures (Grafana provisioning, VPS SSH timeout, missing Tauri signing keys), and update outdated codebase documentation for the multi-package architecture.
summary.outcome: Fixed vault recovery E2E test (protobuf field 1 vs 2 bug + resolveIpns order), resolved all staging deployment blockers via config/secret updates, updated all 7 codebase docs, and fixed writable-shares E2E test (file-ipns key lookup using shareId instead of fileId). All fixes verified locally before pushing.

repo: IPNS records encode the value (CID path) at protobuf field 1, not field 2 — field 2 is signatureV1. recovery.html had this wrong in extractCidFromIpnsRecord.

resolveIpns in recovery.html tried the IPFS gateway HEAD first (15s timeout) before delegated routing — in CI Kubo can't resolve mock-published IPNS names, causing every resolution to waste 15s before falling back.

The Grafana API key for dashboard provisioning is a service account token (from Grafana UI > Service Accounts), separate from the Loki/Prometheus data source keys. It was stored as a repo secret GRAFANA_API_KEY.
TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY and TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD secrets existed in GitHub but were not wired into any of the three desktop build jobs (macOS, Windows, Linux) in deploy-staging.yml.

For standalone file shares (writable), the share_keys table stores the file-ipns key with itemId = the real file UUID, but SharedFileBrowser creates a fake FilePointer using shareId as the id — causing getFileIpnsKeyFn to find no match.
The API must run with NODE_ENV=test to bypass rate throttling during local E2E test runs; development mode causes 429s during full suite execution.
Tauri updater pubkey was added to tauri.conf.json without corresponding workflow changes to pass the private key — the build fails when a pubkey exists but no private key is provided.

code.finding: extractCidFromIpnsRecord checked fieldNumber === 2 (signatureV1) instead of fieldNumber === 1 (value) — delegated routing responses were fetched but never parsed, causing all IPNS resolution to silently fail.
resp.json() and resp.arrayBuffer() were both called on the same response object — double-consume bug fixed by wrapping protobuf parse in an else branch.
Retry backoff with sleep only triggered on thrown errors, not on non-OK HTTP responses (429/5xx). Added !resp.ok check to also trigger backoff on error status codes.

Standalone file share FilePointer used shareId as the file id. Fixed getFileIpnsKeyFn to fall back to finding any file-ipns key when exact itemId match fails — correct for standalone file shares which have exactly one file.
All three tauri-action steps (macOS, Windows, Linux) were missing TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY and TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD env vars despite the secrets existing in GitHub.
Ctrl+S fired immediately after textarea.fill() — React onChange is async so isDirty was still false in the handler closure. Fix: wait for modified status indicator before pressing Ctrl+S.

workflow: Running the full web-e2e suite locally (not just the failing test in isolation) catches different failures that CI hits — including ordering/state dependencies between tests.
Iterating CI fix → push → wait → fail is expensive. Running locally until all pass before committing is the correct approach for E2E tests.
When a worktree is cleaned up, any debug sessions referencing that worktree become stale and should be resolved/archived rather than resumed.
Protobuf field numbers can be inspected at runtime by parsing the raw ArrayBuffer and logging field numbers — useful for debugging IPNS/protobuf issues without full schema knowledge.
gh api graphql reviewThreads query is the reliable way to fetch unresolved PR threads including 'outside of diff range' comments that REST API review listings miss.

friction: Multiple CI round-trips for writable-shares E2E before running locally — the session explicitly called this out as the pattern to avoid.

The stale closure fix (waiting for modified indicator) was the first commit for writable-shares, but the actual root cause was the file-ipns key lookup bug — two separate issues, only one diagnosed from CI logs.
Local full web-e2e suite failures were confusing because they were rate-throttle failures (NODE_ENV=development), not the actual bug — required knowing to restart API with NODE_ENV=test.
markdownlint hook blocked the codebase doc commit due to emphasis-as-heading (MD036) and bare code fences across multiple generated files — required extra fix round.
The Grafana 404 error message ('Grafana returned HTTP 404 — check GRAFANA_URL') was misleading; the URL was correct but the API key was expired/deleted.
Worktrees left behind from previous sessions needed manual cleanup before starting new branch work.
open_items: The vault-migration-iife-silent-failure debug session was marked resolved based on assumption that phase 20 work fixed it — not verified against current codebase.
